Evidence: Sardar Patel ne kaha ki jo Muslims India mein ab bhi hain, un sab ne Pakistan banane mein madad ki. Unhone ye bhi kaha ki unki loyalty par sawaal kyun uthaya ja raha hai, jabki unhe khud apne dil se padhna chahiye. Patel ne ye bhi kaha ki Pakistan aur India ko milne ki baat karne se bachna chahiye, aur unka mazak bhi udhaya. Yeh sab baatein unhone apne speech mein kahi thi (Source 3).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se pata chalta hai ki Sardar Patel ne Muslims ki loyalty par sawaal uthaya aur unse kaha ki unhe apne dil se padhna chahiye. Unhone ye bhi kaha ki unhone Pakistan banane mein madad ki thi, jo claim ke core assertion ko support karta hai. Isliye, yeh evidence claim ko support karta hai.
